companyDescription: AI cloud / neocloud · GPU infrastructure for hyperscalers and AI labs · $104B revenue backlog, FY26 revenue guide $12.4-13.2B · ~$50B debt load under bond-market stress
priceNote: Live $48.73 on Nov 11, 2026 (prior close; ~+5.7% after hours on Q3). The prior report (Oct 26) used $53.64, a -9.2% drift. The stock is ~-40% over the past month in the AI-infrastructure selloff.
summary: RESOLVED (Q3, Nov 10) — a double beat and raise. Revenue was $3.66B (+168% y/y) vs ~$3.55B est. Backlog is ~$132.5B (from ~$104B in June), the FY26 guide was raised to $13.0–13.3B, and the exit-2026 run-rate target is $20–21B. Capex is $37–39B. Shares rose ~5.7% after hours, after a ~-40% month on AI-capex/regulation fears. The leverage concern is unchanged (interest expense was $640M in Q2). With no dated catalyst left, the report goes post-stage. Core Base bias +23.7pp vs realized 14d P75 +6.6%, so Base is a multi-week horizon, not a 14-day call.
risks: Credit stress: 2031 bond yields briefly >16% and CDS >1,000bp — the equity is subordinated to a stressed capital structure.
Q3 interest expense of $860-940M against a modest operating profit; any slip in operating leverage widens losses fast.
Neocloud sector narrative risk (Gartner: 80% of neoclouds gone by 2030; public skepticism from prominent tech figures).
Customer concentration in a handful of hyperscalers/AI labs; contract renegotiation risk if AI capex cools.
Earnings date is an aggregator estimate (~Nov 10), not yet company-confirmed.

macroRisk.rateOutlook: The Fed held at 3.75–4.00% on Oct 28. After the hot Oct CPI on Nov 10, CME FedWatch prices a +25bp hike at the Dec 9 FOMC at ~89–100%, with ~10% odds of 50bp. The 10-year is ~4.98%.
macroRisk.inflationNote: Oct CPI: headline +0.4% m/m, core +0.3% m/m vs 0.2% expected. Sep core PCE 3.1% y/y. Oct PCE (Nov 25) and Nov CPI (Dec 10) are next.
macroRisk.sectorImpact: ~$50B of debt with Q3 interest guided at $860-940M — the stock is now a credit trade. Every bp on yields hits both its cost of capital and the equity multiple.
macroRisk.summary: MEDIUM — a 25bp December hike is priced after the hot CPI. The tails are a 50bp move or a hot Nov 25 PCE, both of which hit small caps first, so the dip entry is preferred.
